Subarnarekha Valley Corporation 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Uttar Pradesh · IN 
 
 No. CC/43/2010/048 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Canal Lining - Uttar Pradesh Pkg-48" (irrigation), awarded to M/s National
 Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on
 2010-07-29 at a gross executed value of INR 13.56 Cr (Rupees 13.56 Crore Only).
 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
 completion of the final inspection. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Gautam Joshi. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Subarnarekha Valley Corporation
